value.rationale: A natural geometric renormalization scale-hit probability is determined at every lattice level and its threshold-crossing overshoot distribution is determined at every finite threshold by explicit rational functions. The nontrivial four-phase oscillation is invisible to generic renewal limits, and the full crossing law quantitatively measures skipped nested spatial scales; both enrich the exact geometry of a well-studied planar model without requiring a general new renewal principle.
